Yl.bar_b_note: A naturalistic brown-furred wolf at Stormursa-bar quality with grounded faints carries it; the even mid-brown coat with no rim light or value break keeps the face soft at small size.

Md.bar_b_note: Side B's indigo-and-white storm wolf matches the Tanglevolt bar with a readable rear-up hit react and grounded faints; side A sinks because its faint frames turn into a black-and-white blotched material and its hit react looks the same as standing.

Ts.bar_b_note: Each site has a distinct aftermath, but blurry, uniform grass-carpet ground, flat noon light, a plain stretched-texture tunnel wall and sparse props sit well below Palworld density and Valheim atmosphere.

Ba.bar_b_note: A clean, appealing stylised elder with readable eyes, a strong silhouette and an earthy green/brown villager palette that fits the key art; only neutral stage light holds it back.

Xr.bar_b_note: Very dark low-contrast frames, no visible purple storm sky or lightning, flat magenta ground rings for telegraphs and HUD panels covering much of the frame sink it; side A also loses the camera to canopy in several frames.

top_changes.change: Xr: swap the flat magenta ring and slab telegraphs for real-object effects (lightning, stone or web strike with an impact), lift the exposure and rim light on both fighters, add camera collision against trunks and canopy, and shrink the debug-style HUD panels that cover the action.

Ts: make each after frame fully clear the enemy's occupation (remove the oxblood banners that stay up in side B rows 1, 2, 3 and 5), and break up the uniform blurry grass carpet with paths, clearings, groves and site-specific props under warmer directional light.

Md side A: fix the faint-state material swap so the coat stays the indigo/white storm fur through faint mid and faint end, and give the hit react a pose that reads differently from standing (as side B does).
